title: Jamaican Jerk Chicken Stew
description: A flavorful and aromatic stew made with Jamaican jerk seasoning and smoky chicken. This dish is perfect for a cozy evening.

ingredients.name: aromatic
ingredients.amount: 2 sprigs fresh thyme, 1 sprig fresh rosemary

ingredients.name: stew
ingredients.amount: 1 large onion, chopped, 2 cloves garlic, minced, 1 large red bell pepper, chopped

instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion, garlic, and red bell pepper to the pot and cook until the vegetables are softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the jerk seasoning, thyme, and rosemary to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, until the chicken is cooked through, about 20 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the pot and shred it with two forks.
Return the shredded chicken to the pot and stir to combine.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
Note: If using Scotch bonnet pepper, wear gloves when handling and use sparingly, as it is very spicy.
